text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been playing with this little
girl while
she waits for her mom to finish
work.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
She wants to play tag today, but it's not
very fun
with just two players, sooo...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to join us? Only if you
want to, of
course! Whaddya say?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'm used to looking after my
little sisters, but even I'm not good
enough to pull off tag with
only two
players...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but don't feel obligated to go
all-out with us
or anything! I know you're
probably tired from
work and all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew, great work! Who knew playing tag
at such
a leisurely pace would be so fun!
choice_data_list: Keep it casual and just have fun.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I conserved a lot of energy by casually
jogging most of the time, so it was super
easy to sprint at
my target at the very
last moment!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup! Y'know what? I think that
ended up
being great training! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Great job! Honestly... I wasn't expecting
you to
play tag with as much enthusiasm
as the kid...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But I was impressed! You were so cool!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Even I got caught up in you guys' energy
and got
all worked up! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm exhausted from the game of tag, but
seeing
Ines Fujin run up close was a very
educational
experience.
